reconfigure.title: [%key:component::ariston_net::config::step::user::sections::advanced::name%]
reconfigure.description: Change the Ariston cloud API settings. The integration logs in with the saved account to check them.

data_description.api_url_setting: Address of the Ariston cloud API. Default: {api_url_setting}
data_description.api_user_agent: Name this integration sends to the Ariston cloud. Default: {api_user_agent}

error.invalid_api_settings: The Ariston cloud did not accept these settings with the saved login. Check the URL and the user agent.

abort.no_devices_found: This Ariston account has no device.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This Ariston account does not have the configured device anymore.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the device state, in seconds. Use at least {scan_interval_min}: the Ariston cloud blocks accounts that poll too often.
data_description.enable_energy: Read energy use from the cloud. Turn off to send fewer requests.
data_description.energy_scan_interval: How often to read energy use, in minutes. Use at least {energy_scan_interval_min}: the Ariston cloud blocks accounts that poll too often.
data_description.enable_bus_errors: Read the error list of the device from the cloud. Turn off to send fewer requests.
data_description.bus_errors_scan_interval: How often to read the error list, in seconds. Use at least {bus_errors_scan_interval_min}: the Ariston cloud blocks accounts that poll too often.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a whole number from {scan_interval_min} to {scan_interval_max}.
error.invalid_energy_scan_interval: Enter a whole number from {energy_scan_interval_min} to {energy_scan_interval_max}.
error.invalid_bus_errors_scan_interval: Enter a whole number from {bus_errors_scan_interval_min} to {bus_errors_scan_interval_max}.
